Notice:
Starting 12/26/2024 we will be asking for the miles each load of corn is hauled from where it was loaded to Bushmills. The mileage will be entered on the inbound scale and if you haul from the same site will only have to be confirmed each load and not re-entered. This number will only be used to calculate an average number of miles every bushel of corn dumped at Bushmills is hauled. The average miles is used in reporting for Carbon Intensity scoring. The individual mileage numbers will not be shared outside of Bushmills.
